model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates how trajectory length varies as a function of the parameter γ for three outcome categories (Unsuccessful, All, Successful). The x-axis is labeled γ, uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.85 to 1.00, with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.02 intervals (0.86, 0.88, …, 1.00). The y-axis is labeled “Trajectory length,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from about 10 to 22 with tick marks every 2 units. Three dashed lines with circular markers and vertical error bars are shown: the Unsuccessful series is red with a dashed line and red circle markers, rising from about 17.0 at γ≈0.85 to about 17.5 at 0.90, about 18.8 at 0.95, about 19.0 at 0.99, and about 21.2 at 1.00; the All series is blue with a dashed line and blue circle markers, increasing from about 15.3 at γ≈0.85 to about 16.0 at 0.90, about 16.9 at 0.95, about 17.1 at 0.99, and about 19.1 at 1.00; the Successful series is green with a dashed line and green circle markers, increasing from about 10.6 at γ≈0.85 to about 12.6 at 0.90, about 12.9 at 0.95, about 13.3 at 0.99, and about 15.3 at 1.00.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates how trajectory length varies with the parameter γ for three series labeled “Unsuccessful,” “All,” and “Successful,” each shown with error bars. The x-axis is labeled “γ” and uses a linear scale spanning approximately 0.85 to 1.00, with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.86, 0.88, 0.90, …, 1.00 (interval 0.02). The y-axis is labeled “Trajectory length” on a linear scale, ranging from about 10 to 22 with tick marks every 2 units (10, 12, 14, …, 22). The “Unsuccessful” series is drawn in red with circular markers connected by a dashed line; it rises from about 16.9 at γ≈0.85 to about 17.4 at 0.90, about 18.7 at 0.95, about 19.0 at 0.99, and about 21.2 at 1.00, with visibly larger error bars near the right end. The “All” series is blue with circular markers and a dashed line; it increases from about 15.3 at γ≈0.85 to about 16.0 at 0.90, about 16.9 at 0.95, about 17.0 at 0.99, and then to about 19.2 at 1.00, with error bars shown at each point. The “Successful” series is green with circular markers and a dashed line; it goes from about 10.6 at γ≈0.85 to about 12.6 at 0.90, about 12.9 at 0.95, about 13.3 at 0.99, and about 15.3 at 1.00, also with error bars that appear larger at γ=1.00 than at earlier γ values.
